name: harmonized_grid_analysis

agent_tool.name: urban_python
agent_tool.usage: Replace the script path with the actual file. script is not a shell command or inline code. Put every CLI flag/value in args as separate strings. Use absolute --out paths when saving into a research run; cwd otherwise defaults to script parent.
agent_tool.errors: A nonzero exit is a failed tool call, not a completed analysis. Read its diagnostic and correct arguments before claiming an artifact exists.

input: Corrected, already-harmonized grid CSVs and metric coordinates in data/; never cached results.
scope: OLS and fixed/adaptive bisquare GWR, eight predictors; full-sample exploration primary, shared-region OOF auxiliary.

actions.inventory: Columns, shapes, missing/nonfinite counts, hashes, support counts; optional --out saves full JSON.
actions.feasibility: Geometry-only neighbour scan. --model plus arbitrary --bandwidths; --validation shared_regions adds holdouts. Optional --out saves CSV/JSON.
actions.fit: Actually compute from input rows. --out required, new/empty. Full-sample coefficients always included; default validation none.
actions.compare: --out names run or parent; filter --scales/--model/--variables. Verify hashes, save complete comparison CSV, print <=3000-char preview. No winner selected.

parameters.--model: ols | gwr_fixed | gwr_adaptive; fit default ols, feasibility default both GWR
parameters.--bandwidths: Comma-separated positive fixed metres or adaptive fractions (0,1]; specify --model; omit for OLS
parameters.--variables: Compare-only exact predictor names or intercept, comma-separated

coefficient_units.native: log1p(stay_count) response per original predictor unit, intercept at X=0
coefficient_units.x_standardized: log1p(stay_count) response per training-sample predictor standard deviation (ddof=0); y NOT standardized, intercept at training predictor means

numerics: Train-only median imputation/StandardScaler. Minimum 20 neighbours, weight floor 1e-12. Adaptive ceil(fraction*n_train) with floor20. Fixed radius never expands. All local ranks/conditions/radii retained.
safety: Nonempty fit outputs refused; failed runs labeled; input/code/output hashes. No network/raw aggregation/plotting.
claim_limits: No optimal choice, causal effects or significance tests
Do not conflate full-sample and OOF
Quadrants: per-support median-coordinate split, not matched zones
Two sampled days, fixed zoning; not population-wide or complete MAUP
